name: @jacobmolz/mcpguard
stderr:
Usage: mcp-guard [options] [command]

Security proxy for MCP servers

Options:
  -V, --version              output the version number
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  start [options]            Start the MCP-Guard daemon
  stop [options]             Stop the running daemon
  connect [options]          Start a bridge to proxy an MCP server through the
                             daemon
  status [options]           Show daemon status
  health [options]           Check daemon health (exit 0 if healthy, 1 if not)
  dashboard-token [options]  Display the dashboard auth token
  validate [options]         Validate config file
  logs [options]             Query audit logs
  auth                       Manage OAuth authentication
  init [options]             Generate mcp-guard.yaml from existing MCP client
                             configs
  help [command]             display help for command
